notes.title: [1.1.0.1 Patch Note] Story Mode and Challenge Mode now available！
notes.notes:
Hello, heroes!
The version 1.1.0.1 update is here, with 2 new mode unveiled. 

1. Mode Selection:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/c5ebd9bf629792bd1a0b6afc852a799eb39f6651.png

1. Story Mode - Free to go
-Combat is relatively simple, suitable for friends who plays the game for the first time.
-In this mode, players can initially choose the "Flying Fairy" set, which helps quickly enhance attributes.
-This mode is primarily designed to allow new players to experience the game's story. The console can be activated in-game; if you encounter challenging levels or conditions that can't be triggered, feel free to modify it.
Note: This mode is relatively easy and can be modified at will, thus achievements cannot be triggered and it does not support cycle inheritance. Please keep this in mind.

2. Jianghu Mode - Mad world
The combat difficulty is moderate, more recommended for players who have some understanding of the game.
This mode is the original game mode, so if you wish to experience the authentic gameplay, continue to select this mode!

3. Challenge Mode - Fire Hell
-This mode features extremely challenging combat.
-It is suitable for players who are very familiar with the game's development paths and ideally have items from multiple cycles to aid them.
-Players will receive the "Flying Fairy" set at the start of this mode.
-You can obtain the "Master Gardener" set from the old monk in the south of Xiangyang City.
PS: Even with the support of these two sets, combat remains difficult, so grab your divine gear and start challenging!
Completing this mode unlocks exclusive achievements.
Recently, I had a chance to experience the Challenge Mode, and the enemies presented a certain level of difficulty.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/349f8211a5804be7f97a1eff3ccb3397c06ca8a0.jpg
PS: In the initial phases, try to stay away from grassy areas; the enemies there... can be quite oppressive...

How to Activate the Console in Story Mode
Here are some quick console usage methods and useful in-game codes:
1) How to open the console: Press the TAB key during the game.
2) To acquire items: "getitem itemID quantity” (e.g., getitem 1001 1).
PS: To delete an item, change the quantity to a negative number, e.g., -1 will decrease the count by one.
3) To increase attributes: "modiattr attribute value" (e.g., modiattr HP 9999).
PS: To decrease attributes, use a negative number, e.g., modiattr ATK -100 will reduce attack by 100 points.
4) To add traits: "gettrait traitID +" (e.g., gettrait 10127 +).

Here are some commonly used item and trait IDs :

Here are two more fun things for everyone:
-Speed Code: "setspeed 5". Once activated, you'll move like the wind! 
-Scroll Creation Code: Traitscroll&TraitID - For example, to obtain a scroll for the Silent Steps trait, open the console and enter: getitem Traitscroll&T10034 1, which will create a scroll that can be used by your teammates.

PS:  Remember to save your game before making changes and keep a clean save file to avoid any anomalies that may affect gameplay. The addition of the console aims to enhance players' enjoyment, allowing them to experience storylines that were previously difficult to access. I hope everyone can complete the game in whatever way they prefer!
Feel free to discover more fun console codes and item/trait IDs on your own, and share your findings with one another!
Lastly, thank you to all the players! Enjoy your gaming experience!

notes.title: The World of Kungfu Full Release on Steam Set for October 24th
notes.notes:
Stormy times in Jianghu, heroes unite in the Central Plains!
The full version of The World of Kungfu: Dragon and Eagle is officially set to release on Steam on October 24th. This update will bring the complete storyline, including the final chapters of the main story. Players who already own the game will receive the full version as a free update.

[previewyoutube=ZbDv767ZlsQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Haven't picked up the game yet? Head to the Steam store now to add it to your wishlist or purchase it!
In addition to Steam, the full version will also be available on the WeGame platform and the Nintendo Switch eShop (available in Hong Kong, Korea, the US, and Europe). Stay tuned if you're interested!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/08456c754f7bac2fc801112717348944645b8184.png

About the Full Version
The full version will be launched on October 24th as an update to the base game on Steam, bringing with it the Central Plains storyline. With nearly 400,000 characters of new content in the Central Plains chapter, the complete storyline now spans around 650,000 characters in total, offering more than 40 hours of single-playthrough content.
In this expansive martial world, the major storylines of the Ragger Ranger, Feather Robes, Wulu Palace, and Mt. Heng will finally come to their thrilling conclusions, delivering an exhilarating journey through the Jianghu.

notes.title: 2024/09/13 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Both the default branch and the testing branch have been updated.

EA Default Branch Update Notes:
-[Inheritance Fix] Inheritance NPCs can now inherit multiple items. The rules are: +1 item inherited per playthrough, with a maximum of +5. The "No Regrets" trait can provide an additional +1. In the first few playthroughs, you can rely on "No Regrets" to further increase the inheritance count. Once the maximum inheritance of 5 is reached, "No Regrets" will no longer add to the inheritance count.
PS: Fixed the issue where filtering items would cause "bad things" when inheriting items...

-[Martial Arts Fix] Fixed the issue where martial arts did not increase properly when leveling up.

-[Animal Fix] Fixed the issue where animals, such as lotus ducks, could not learn animal-type martial arts.

-[Self-Creation Fix] Fixed the issues with abnormal attributes for swordsmanship, blade technique, and insight/strength when creating self-made martial arts. If there are any issues with self-created martial arts, we can communicate and adjust at any time.

In addition to the fixes mentioned above, the testing branch also includes the following fixes and adjustments:
- [Breakthrough Fix] Fixed the issue where damage and inner strength increased in a way that caused discrepancies when breaking through martial arts star levels. Some martial arts were dealing less damage the more they broke through.
PS: We hope everyone can test this fix together; if there are any anomalies, we will optimize and adjust accordingly.
PS: The issue where self-created martial arts had two critical damage entries.

-[New Items] Added several items to create traps in the scene for identified items. We hope you will enjoy these little things

-Fixed some martial arts and traits:
1)Fixed the anomaly with the traits of the Eastern Book Sect's 7, 8, and 9-star martial arts.
2)Fixed the issue where Hengshan disciples would recover health excessively on critical hits. Now, Hengshan disciples will recover 1% of their health on critical hits, which is a significant reduction, but still quite practical since Hengshan has many rapid-fire martial arts; each critical hit allows for recovery.
3)Fixed the issue where some wanted criminals in the Central Plains could not act, and slightly increased the attributes of some wanted criminals.
4)Fixed some abnormal entries in the martial arts collection and removed unnecessary displays of martial arts.
5)Fixed the issue where the Song Mingguang Armor would override other enhancement attributes.

-Adjusted the Four Absolutes to ignore all abnormalities; players can test this out now. The Four Absolutes can be affected by certain abnormal damage, so we hope debuff-oriented players can take them down.
-Story fix for the Eastern Book Sect where encountering Shangguan Nan was not required to recruit him directly.

-Added a new illustration for the Floating Iron Cavalry. If you like it, you can recruit this black-faced new follower.

notes.title: The World of Kungfu Official Version Delay Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players, we apologize for the delay in our original plan to start testing and release in Q2. We're sorry for the inconvenience.
Based on our current progress, we expect to begin testing in August. After testing, there will be a brief adjustment period before the official version is released. Thank you for your patience!

Reasons for the Delay:
The original EA script was intended to be 200,000 Chinese characters, with the Central Plains chapter estimated at 250,000 Chinese characters. However, the final script for the Central Plains chapter expanded to 400,000 Chinese characters, pushing the total storyline script beyond 600,000 Chinese characters (excluding skills, equipment, anecdotes, and character info). In addition to the three main storylines, various character arcs will also unfold within the Central Plains chapter. Player choices will not only influence different endings but also have the potential to reshape history. The intricate branching paths necessitate extensive debugging and dialogue refinement, contributing to the delays.

Preview of New Content for the Official Release:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/3dca5dfc165b5ab9dd7cbc5a845c9eca6206ae06.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/7efd3edcedab2c3689c3e6c7a19a1ac092caadfa.png

Recommendations for the Central Plains Chapter:
1. There are 10 main storylines available, including Ragged Ranger, Feather Robe, Wulu Palace, Shaolin, Mount Heng, Prodigy of the East, Wide of the West, and Recluse of the North.

2. Each of these storylines contains hidden branches, leading to a total of 17 different endings.

3. Players can unlock the final fate of teammates in each storyline. In the Ragged Ranger storyline, players have the chance to unlock endings for all martial characters apart from the main ones. The endings for the same character vary depending on the storyline chosen.

4. Some storylines feature romantic confession plots❤, and the characters available for confession may differ slightly based on the protagonist's gender. However, for certain unconventional martial artists, gender norms may not be so rigid...

5. In one storyline, players will change the course of real history.

6. In another storyline, players can mediate between sects & forces, prevent the collapse of the dynasty, and trigger a perfect ending. A prophet at a certain ferry crossing will provide hints for the perfect storyline.

7. The scope of each storyline varies. It is recommended to start with the Feather Robe > Wulu Palace > Ragged Ranger (without joining any sect) for the first playthrough, and then explore other storylines after becoming familiar with the background.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/599cfe6a2ffc0a37804aa0931bade23a49aaae8f.png

Preview of New Teammates in the Central Plains Chapter:
In addition to the teammates from the EA version, the Central Plains chapter introduces new martial world characters:
1. Chen Sengzhi and Chen Nanxu, descendants of a noble family devastated by tragedy, searching for their lost relatives.

2. Huoshaoyun of the desert, a bandit of mixed Uyghur and Han heritage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/7655843ebc99ed8ccc566e2c6b3447cc56322bca.png

3. Utu Kunmi, the owner of the Kunmi King’s Tomb.

  Within the mysterious Kunmi King’s Tomb in the Western Regions, a blood pool formed from the blood of countless souls lies hidden...

4. The passionate youth at the Lankao Ferry: Tan Fu.

5. Even the Four Talents of Jiangnan will have their moment to shine.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/8b72eabf8cadae8afa208f328dbc40a556c30fc2.png
  Every character will have a complete life story. The Four Talents of Jiangnan will continue their tales in the martial world.

6. In addition to new teammates, more followers will be available for you to recruit.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/f64df41971e47985f90689b115b63a9c3a326f99.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/f0790822e3f221d6e2f1d890ffe33bca66f61b8b.png
  All of the above characters have the opportunity to join your team or become followers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/0772c23b479618a89299039aaf50082759e2edf7.png

Separated Aspects
In the Central Plains chapter, you will reunite with an old friend along with the Ragged Brother. The old friend mentioned that you and Wanyan Yong were Separated Aspects who would never see each other again. Now, at this crossroads, your paths may lead to an uncertain future.

*Separated Aspects: "the incompatibility of Shen and Shang stars." This phrase originates from ancient Chinese astronomy and literature, specifically referring to the stars Shen (Orion) and Shang (Antares). These stars are noted for their astronomical opposition: when one rises, the other sets, symbolizing separation and discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672139/80d18eeebe33ca94c0957b98815beb6026e6bf39.png

The official demo is now available on Steam. You can download it directly, for the trial process, please refer to the previous announcement.
Next, we'll prioritize optimizing the storyline and performance of the official version, aiming to start testing and launch as soon as possible!

notes.title: The World of Kungfu Set to Launch in English Version by Q2 2024
notes.notes:
The game will present a vast story spanning 10 years with a cast of over 100 characters. Its Early Access version covers the first half of the epic saga (with Chinese language support only), and more is to come in the full release coming next year.

We're working on the full release with a focus on refining the storyline for each sect and key character. As we approach the finale of our Jianghu story, the main characters' arcs will be tied up in a way that will be sure to pack an emotional punch.

Join Us at Pax West 2023!
We're excited to announce our presence at Pax West this year! Join us at booth number 659 from September 1st to September 4th to experience the debut of our English demo.

... And the Latest Scoop of the Full Release

More Stories: Be the Master of a Wulin Sect
In the full release, players should be able to join any of the 9 sects and gangs including Shaolin, Quanzhen, and Mt. Heng. Each sect has its unique story to uncover, exclusive martial arts to learn, and special companions to recruit. Players can leave their sect after joining, though leaving might bring hefty consequences.

Some sects offer an evil storyline branch, allowing players to murder their shifu and establish their own name.

Bigger World: An Extended Map
Besides the 4 areas of the south in the EA version, the full version will encompass the Central Plains, Northern Desert, and West Regions.

Character Portraits
Currently, we're creating character portraits for all the NPCs that players can come across in the game, including both key characters that play significant roles in your adventure, as well as less relevant NPCs like random men and women you meet in the street.

Portraits of all potential companions and other key characters will be meticulously illustrated to reflect their persona. Even for the same character, new appearances will be unlocked as the story progresses.

The achievement system is in the debugging phase and will also be included in the full release if development progresses as expected.
